title: Cancellation with twenty-five days notice
narrative: They cancelled my flight almost a month ahead and refunded me. I have read that I am owed compensation for any cancellation.

documents.content:
BOOKING AC6620 — Passenger: M. SORENSEN (adult)
Carrier: Auroral (AC)
AC910  ARN 12 Dec 2026 07:25  ->  LHR 12 Dec 2026 09:05
Great-circle distance ARN-LHR: 1,455 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: notices@auroral.example
Sent: 16 Nov 2026 14:00 UTC
Subject: AC910 12 Dec cancelled

AC910 on 12 December will not operate. Your booking has been cancelled and refunded in full.

AURORAL OPS LOG — AC910 / 12DEC2026
Status: CANCELLED (winter schedule reduction, decision date 16NOV)
Cause code: COM-SCHED
Cause text: Route suspended for the winter season. Commercial decision.

derivation: S4.1 notice 16 Nov 14:00 -> 12 Dec 07:25 is 25 days
S4.2 21 days or more -> no compensation
Cause being carrier-controlled does not survive the notice ladder
